text: The threshold breach is **primarily driven by CMS p95 variance**, not WMS slowness: - When CMS performs well (p95=2600ms): WMS ratio = 4000/2600 = 1.54x (fail) - When CMS is slower (p95=3150ms): WMS ratio = 4000/3150 = 1.27x (pass) - **Root cause:** Median-based comparison amplifies variance from the fastest module (CMS)
